item.title: Trump-backed Republican battles to hold key Florida seat in president's stomping ground
item.description: Trump-endorsed Republican Jon Maples faces Democrat Emily Gregory in a Florida House District 87 special election in Palm Beach, home to Mar-a-Lago.

item.title: Greater weight loss promised by higher-dose Wegovy shot, now approved by FDA
item.description: The FDA approved Wegovy HD, a higher-dose semaglutide for weight loss in adults with obesity, offering greater weight reduction, as experts warn of side effects.

item.title: Trump taps Nick Adams for patriotic, pro-America special presidential envoy role
item.description: President Donald Trump has tapped Nick Adams for the position of special presidential envoy for American tourism, exceptionalism and values.

item.title: Jack Smith team secretly sought years of Kash Patel phone records, new docs show
item.description: Former special counsel Jack Smith sought more than two years’ worth of phone records for now-FBI Director Kash Patel while Smith was investigating President Donald Trump.

item.title: Charles Barkley delivers stern message to parents who don't 'whoop' their kids: 'I believe in discipline'
item.description: Charles Barkley said during a March Madness interview that modern athletes are uncoachable and argued that strict parenting, including discipline, is necessary for kids today.

item.title: IL Dems decline to defend ‘no’ votes on Laken Riley Act after student’s killing tied to repeat offender
item.description: Illinois Democrats stay silent on their no votes on the Laken Riley Act after Loyola student Sheridan Gorman was allegedly killed by an illegal immigrant.

item.title: Democrat strategist warns Mamdani's ballooning NYC budget plan gives Republicans a ready-made midterm message
item.description: Democratic strategist Melissa DeRosa says NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani's $127B budget hands Republicans a perfect midterm attack on tax-and-spend Democrats.

item.title: Barry Manilow reveals how routine doctor visit for hip pain uncovered hidden cancer diagnosis
item.description: Barry Manilow, 82, reveals a doctor's decision to scan his lungs during a hip pain visit uncovered a stage 1 lung cancer diagnosis with no symptoms.

item.title: CNN, MS NOW avoid covering Loyola student Sheridan Gorman murdered by illegal immigrant in Chicago
item.description: The murder of 18-year-old Loyola University Chicago student Sheridan Gorman by an illegal immigrant received no coverage on CNN and MS NOW, according to transcripts.
